name: @nexttime/web
description: React + Vite SPA served statically by caddy: chat, approvals, tasks, connections, audit/explain (design doc §7.6). `dist/` is the Vite static build, baked into the caddy image at build time (deploy/caddy/Dockerfile builds this package and copies dist/ to /srv/web) — not bind-mounted; rebuild the caddy image to deploy a web change.
